authority_boundary: All remediation limits, mechanisms, evaluations and falsifiers are SECONDARY_AI design proposals. Reported ICE observations and prior synthetic calculation are not new user measurements, implementations, runtime rewards or efficacy evidence.

anchors.name: ICE ORCA DRAGON consumer feedback and HSWM repair

properties.name: HSWM ICE learning remediation design — corrected v2
properties.description: Corrected successor to v1: v1 has invalid semantic remediation mappings; this source-bound design proposal records the repaired mapping without claiming implementation or efficacy.

properties.name: I1 mixed contribution prevents additional-effect identification
properties.description: ICE question, source, model and reviewer contributions are confounded; no absence-of-effect conclusion follows.

properties.name: I2 mutually exclusive guards prevent selection-effect measurement
properties.description: Pre-filtered exclusive routes cannot demonstrate a score-driven choice improvement between them.

properties.name: I3 representation-size-sensitive equal feature updates
properties.description: Shared update magnitude across bias, fields and pairs changes total logit response with representation size.

properties.name: I4 feedback lacks output and nested trajectory identity
properties.description: Root feedback does not receive stage/output digest identity; declared automatic outcomes remain distinct.

properties.name: I5 consumer cost lacks matched comparator and complete accounting
properties.description: Recorded recovery/time lacks comparator and total cost, so net utility improvement is unmeasured.

properties.name: I6 learned child guard does not preserve parent scope
properties.description: Static review finds specialization replaces rather than composes parent guard; out-of-scope execution was not observed.

properties.name: M1 co-eligible alternatives and preserved eligibility
properties.description: Record candidates/rejections/revisions and keep eligibility AND learned condition separate.

properties.name: M2 feature-normalized update and experience reliability separation
properties.description: Compare one feature-count-normalized learner version with old rule; do not call small-n scores calibrated.

properties.name: M3 output-bound idempotent feedback
properties.description: Bind review, occurrence, selected relation revision, output digest, rubric and provenance; update only the evaluated relation.

properties.name: M4 evidence-grounded question and action revision
properties.description: Propose condition/read/question/action changes with predecessor and falsifier; observe resolver bytes and action trace.

properties.name: M5 lifecycle cost and model migration accounting
properties.description: Separate setup, recurring and migration costs; keep old learner state immutable and evaluate version migration explicitly.

properties.name: E1 fixed-question local selection comparison
properties.description: Hold question/resources/candidates/model/tools/budget/rubric fixed while experience may change selection.

properties.name: E2 goal-level question-generation comparison
properties.description: Hold goal/resources/model/tools/budget/rubric fixed while questions/read-set/order may change.

properties.name: E3 model and harness migration comparison
properties.description: Compare new model with old/reviewed state and native-history control as a migration candidate, not HSWM causal proof.

properties.name: F1 co-eligibility and state-mediation falsifier
properties.description: Reject selection-effect design when alternatives are cosmetic, unavailable, resource-unequal, or sensitive removal changes nothing.

properties.name: F2 representation normalization falsifier
properties.description: Retire candidate if held-out quality/selection worsens, interactions are lost, or new-context adaptation becomes too slow.

properties.name: F3 feedback attribution falsifier
properties.description: Reject output/revision mismatch, duplicate replay learning, or update to an unreviewed relation.

properties.name: F4 question/action change falsifier
properties.description: Reject when questions change without read/action change, answer leakage occurs, or retrospection worsens later decisions.

properties.name: F5 net-cost falsifier
properties.description: Reject developer-tool value in scope if equal-quality recurring cost or human burden rises and recovery is not observed.

properties.name: Parent eligibility preservation contract
properties.description: Child specialization must preserve parent mandatory guard through explicit composition or equivalent truth-table contract.

properties.name: Learner version and immutable migration contract
properties.description: New update semantics require new learner identity; old revisions/digests are not silently reinterpreted.

properties.name: Review identity and supersession contract
properties.description: Review IDs are idempotent, output/rubric-bound, and correlated resubmissions do not create independent experience.

properties.name: Pre-outcome question and action trace contract
properties.description: Question, expected change, source version/range, action trace and falsifier precede outcome interpretation.

properties.name: v1 semantic mapping correction record
properties.description: v1 remains structurally published but its remediation mapping is invalid; use HSWM ICE learning remediation design — corrected v2 (sym:AbstractNode:hswm-ice-learning-remediation-2026-09-08-v2) for recommendations.

properties.name: Bounded engineering workflow verification
properties.description: Document/self-development workflow verification is source-bound and does not implement remediation or demonstrate efficacy.
